frame: origin at tray center; +z up; tray mid-plane z=0.098 m; base z=0
mass_case: bare tray, no ballast; emergent C3D8I solid mass ~3.086 kg
boundary_condition: feet fixed; source plate not modeled
joint_status: RIGID (truss two-force => moment-free/spherical; RBE3 distributing over bracket footprint)
frequency_label: PROVISIONAL UPPER BOUND (rigid joints; real compliant joints lower these)

element_types.tray: C3D8I 8-node incompatible-mode hexahedron (accurate bending vs plain C3D8)
element_types.joints: RBE3 distributing coupling (DCOUP3D) over rod-end bracket footprint; feet fixed

note_dense_flex_cluster: the tray is supported at only the 3 apex points (radius 110 mm); its 4 corners/edges overhang and produce a dense set of low-participation corner/edge-flap tray-flex modes near ~337 Hz. These are physical (not spurious): C3D8I incompatible-mode bending is softer/more accurate than locked full-integration H8, so it places the first tray-flex cluster below the JAX-plate (371 Hz) and TensorMesh locked-H8 (374 Hz) values.
integrity: independent re-derivation; shares only shared/spec.py raw inputs; C3D8I solid tray + truss struts; no porting of K/M, eigen-results, or frequency tables.

mesh_convergence.note: suspension modes (1-4) are nearly mesh-independent; the dense tray-flex cluster (>=mode 5) shifts more as the overhanging-corner bending resolves.
